environment.description: Same Jenkins runner deployment but with LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy (v7.3) running as a sidecar on localhost:8030. The pipeline config references the relay proxy for flag evaluation. The flag 'artifact-extraction-v2' is configured in the LaunchDarkly project 'ci-platform' under environment 'production' with a targeting rule that returns TRUE for all contexts where 'service-type' equals 'ci-runner'. The relay proxy operates in daemon mode with a local Redis-backed persistent store (failover: flag defaults to TRUE via the relay proxy's configured fallback-through-variation set to variation index 1 which maps to boolean true). The SDK initialization uses a 5-second timeout with the relay proxy's streaming endpoint. Additionally, the pipeline config JSON at /etc/ci/extractor.json has manifest_validation set to false (note: this is NOT the control - the flag evaluation is).
